sections.heading: Nature of the Bond
sections.body: This certificate evidences a Contract Performance Bond issued by the Surety on behalf of the Principal in favour of the Obligee, securing the due performance of the Principal's obligations under the agreement for the design, supply, installation and commissioning of a 120-bed critical care block, including medical gas pipeline systems and modular operation theatres, as awarded under the Obligee's letter of acceptance and the contract documents referred to therein.

sections.heading: Conditions of the Bond
sections.body: 1. The liability of the Surety shall not exceed the Bond Amount stated in this certificate. 2. The Surety shall be discharged from all liability unless a written claim is lodged by the Obligee within the validity period of the bond or within the claim period of thirty days thereafter. 3. Any variation in the terms of the underlying contract made without the prior written consent of the Surety shall not enlarge the liability of the Surety. 4. This bond is non-transferable and is governed by the laws of India, with courts at Ernakulam having exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Procedure for Invocation
sections.body: The Obligee may invoke this bond by a written demand addressed to the Kochi Regional Office of the Surety, signed by an officer duly authorised by the Obligee, stating the nature of default by the Principal and enclosing a copy of the notice of default served on the Principal. The Surety shall settle an admissible claim within thirty days of receipt of complete documents, in accordance with the IRDAI (Surety Insurance Contracts) Guidelines.

sections.heading: Indemnity by Principal
sections.body: The Principal and its Trustees have executed a Deed of Indemnity and Counter-Guarantee in favour of the Surety, under which the Principal undertakes to reimburse the Surety for any amount paid under this bond together with costs and expenses incurred in connection therewith.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, the Principal or Obligee may contact the Grievance Officer at the Kochi Regional Office or write to care.kochi@himgiriinsurance.example. If unresolved within thirty days, the complainant may approach the Insurance Ombudsman having jurisdiction over Kerala or register a complaint on the Bima Bharosa portal of IRDAI.
